summary: GMEX Robotics Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing an Exchange Agreement with an institutional holder of its Series C Senior Secured Convertible Notes. The holder exchanged the remaining balance of the Series C Notes for new Series D Notes with substantially similar terms but adjusted pricing, including a provision allowing the company to voluntarily adjust the conversion price to optimize cash flows and capital structure. The exchange was consummated immediately upon execution, relying on the Section 3(a)(9) exemption. No dollar amounts, premium, or advisors were disclosed. The transaction effectively restructures existing debt, reducing near-term dilution risk while maintaining secured status. Watch for continued reliance on convertible financing and potential further conversions or exchanges.
